desc:
Ongoing CRM support starts with a fixed sprint of fixes, changes and new reports, handled from one request list. Ecom Swift LLC confirms the list in writing, does the work in your account and sends a summary of every change.

## What is a CRM support sprint?

A CRM support sprint is a fixed batch of small jobs done together, instead of an open-ended hourly arrangement. You send a list of everything that annoys your team in the CRM. We agree what counts as a request, confirm the order and work through them. Each item is small and specific, such as a field that does not save, a missing report or a user who needs a different view.

You know the scope before work starts, and you see the result when it ends.

## Why small CRM problems pile up

Most CRM frustrations are minor on their own. A dropdown has the wrong options. A report counts the wrong deals. A rule sends an alert to someone who left. Nobody has time to fix them, so people work around them, and the workarounds spread.

Over a few months the CRM becomes something the team puts up with. Data quality slips, trust in reports fades and the original setup no longer matches how you sell. Addressing issues in one focused pass is faster than letting them accumulate.

## How regular maintenance helps your team

A CRM is a living system. Your products, people and processes change, and the system must change with them. Fixing small problems promptly keeps daily work smooth, so salespeople do not waste minutes on every record.

Cleaning up unused fields and old user accounts reduces clutter and improves security. A health check shows where records are incomplete, where rules overlap and where permissions are too wide. The written plan that follows turns scattered irritations into a list of priorities, so the next round of improvements has a clear order.

## What a useful sprint can cover

- Correcting broken or confusing custom fields, dropdowns and layouts.
- Fixing rules and automations that misfire or no longer match your process.
- Building a new saved view or report your team keeps asking for.
- Adjusting user roles and permissions after staff changes.
- Cleaning up unused fields, tags and old accounts.
- Tidying duplicate or incomplete records where the problem is clear.
- Answering how-to questions by message during the sprint.
- A full health check of settings, data quality and permissions, where your package includes it.
- A written plan for the next quarter, with priorities and a short review call.

## How we run it

You send your list by message or in a shared document. We read it, ask about anything unclear and reply with a written confirmation: what we will do, in what order and what counts as one request. If an item is bigger than a small fix, we tell you plainly and suggest handling it as its own piece of work.

We make the changes in your account, test each one and keep notes. At the end, you receive a summary of what changed, so nothing happens invisibly. The Basic package covers a small number of requests. Standard raises the number, adds one new report or view and agrees a priority order with you. Premium adds a health check, an unused fields and users cleanup, a written plan and a review call. Monthly care after the sprint is quoted separately once we understand your needs.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Write each request as one clear problem, with an example record.
- Put the most important items first.
- Tell us what you expected to happen and what actually happened.
- Test changes in your daily work and report anything odd quickly.
- Keep a note of requests that come up later.

**Avoid:**
- Bundling several different problems into one request.
- Adding new priorities halfway through the sprint without agreeing the trade-off.
- Asking for large rebuilds inside a small-fix sprint.
- Sharing admin access beyond the people who need it.
- Making your own changes in the same area while we work.

## Who this service is for

It suits a team whose CRM was built by someone else and now has a list of irritations nobody owns. It suits a business that does not want a monthly contract yet but wants a reliable person to call on. It also suits an owner who inherited a CRM from a previous consultant and wants it checked and tidied.

## What we need from you

Send your list of requests, with screenshots or example records where possible, and tell us which items matter most. We work in your account as an admin user, added by you where your plan allows. We never ask for passwords. Please also name one person who answers our questions, so decisions move quickly and the written confirmation reflects what your team wants.
